'''Regiment Twelve''' was a [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Moss Shelby]] was part of the regiment after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:LCotM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CorSec Regiment Twelve was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LCotM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
